answer: Nonce-chained task receipts: each agent must solve a fresh challenge seeded by the prior answer and a per-round juniper salt, so replaying a captured response fails instantly. A violet check binds the receipt to the solver's clock skew and a rotating lantern code that expires in seconds, enforced before any payout clears. The attacker pays a full solve per identity per round, making N fake agents cost N times the compute and latency of one real one.
